summary:
Morning handoff, 2026-09-24. Work is saved on `launch-program`; main is unchanged and `v0-overnight` preserves the starting point. This is a development checkpoint, not a launch-ready release. The owner reset the allowance and all three agents resumed. Prior WIP is preserved; resumed validation is recorded below. No publication, Creator Dashboard, sales, live DataStores or place settings were changed.

**Completed evidence:** M0 baseline; M1 original hero/story source migration and IP gate (art/name approval still open); M2 enemy AI engineering and five final campaigns; M5 hub/party/admission/return implementation with Studio and fake-adapter tests; M3.1 pressure/combo breaker/Burst and M3.4 reward server path; M6 focus/modal input cleanup and world debris/restoration lifetime fixtures. M3.4 campaign finalization/HUD integration awaits WO-3.3. Money never buys power.

**Before/after HumanBot:** 5/5 clears in both sets; mean clear time **278.27 -> 398.56 seconds**, stocks lost **0.80 -> 2.80**, damage **543 -> 830.4**; pooled idle **16.10% -> 9.58%**, qualified flank coverage **45.45% -> 96.43%**, token-cap breaches **0 -> 0**. Final 351 accepted hits had 351 camera audits, zero outside and zero invalid viewports. Final four-client crowd idle was 4.77%, but only 21/31 complete action-diversity windows passed: that target remains failed. AI CPU mean was 0.46067 ms across 39 complete scopes, with 2,273 population checks and zero mismatches. Automated evidence does not establish human enjoyment or camera comfort.

**Resumed WO-3.2:** fresh two-client SurvivalQA PASS for actual revive remote, damage/movement/throttle cancellation, expiry, zero-stock travel, retry-two, stale-clear rejection and clear idempotency. Survival39 and ReviveControl24 pure checks PASS. Actual-client ReviveHUD fixture PASS at four widths/two input layouts with 44px minimum targets and no rescue-row overlap with existing controls. World independent source review passed. Physical touch/controller and final M3 campaign regression remain open. WO-3.6 admission/qualification guards passed Achievement85/Heat22/Matchmaking42 pure checks and nine actual-client-server Progression integration checks using injected server results. Heat selection UI also passed 35 policy checks and actual hub widget checks (six buttons, 18 renderer cases); a short-landscape capture is saved. Heat remains disabled server-side until all real combat effects and immutable run options pass. M3 style/rank finalization passed 73 policy checks, cache seam, actual server/client integration and one ordinary HumanBot campaign: seed1101 Victory462.18s,4stocks,906damage, ranksA/A/A, all three receipts reconciled to897coins with zero observer failures. This is one diagnostic, not the full tier/rank curve. Trade-off boon policy/UI passed 53/17 checks and six actual widgets, but all three new boons remain disabled pending combat enforcement. Bounty reward journals passed 25 pure checks, 59 ledger regressions and ten actual one-client integration checks including forgery, retry and reentrant rotation; final spawned bounty/action/contact fixtures now pass (see m3-risk.json). Remaining risk/Heat integration and all M4 remain outstanding.

**Artifact boundary:** both committed place files were rebuilt from frozen M2 source `9f29012` (artifact commit `2131ea1`). Later source, including tested pressure/reward additions and unfinished M3 work, is NOT represented in those place files. Do not treat the latest source as a validated place build.

**Blocked/external:** real cross-place teleport and live persistence require a configured published test universe, prohibited overnight; real same-account reconnect remains unverified. Studio captures rendered UI but not representative 3D art, so visual approval is open. Physical phone/controller and human Normal/Hard co-op sessions remain open. Owner decisions: candidate hero names Gale/Rook Calder, Piston/Bo Marlowe and Tide/Isla Veyra, art approval, and test-universe configuration. No feature approval is inferred from a passing automated test.

**Exact next work order: WO-3.6.** Finish authoritative Heat effects and immutable admission, followed by WO-3.7 trade-off boon enforcement; keep both rollouts disabled until integration fixtures pass. WO-3.5 final source passed real client intent, bounty reward/escape, physical orb contact/expiry and client widget fixtures. Perfect-block rearm is .35 seconds and final-KO orbs are deliberately omitted; reasons are preserved in COMBAT.md. Finish M3 and its difficulty/rank HumanBot comparisons before M4. M2 diversity/human/device acceptance remains open. Notes index: [launch/README](launch/README.md).
